snippet.title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is coming to Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PS5, Xbox X|S, and PC! 🎮🖥️

Step into the paws of your own original character and experience life among the Clans in Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest. Explore a vibrant wilderness filled with hidden paths, dangerous rivals, spiritual omens, and unforgettable adventures inspired by the world from the best-selling Warrior Cats books from Erin Hunter.

Choose your Clan, forge bonds with allies, and rise through the ranks as you hunt prey, patrol territories, uncover secrets, and defend your home in strategic turn-based combat. Every journey is shaped by your choices, relationships, and the prophecy guiding your destiny.

Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.

Customize your cat with unique appearances, accessories, attack moves, and den decorations while building your reputation within the Clan. Encounter original characters alongside iconic cats from the Warrior Cats universe as you experience untold stories.

For the Clans! ⚔️🐾
